Busuanga Island is the biggest in the Calamian Group (Palawan, Philippines) and the province's second largest - after Palawan Island. It is located halfway between the islands of Mindoro and Palawan, with the South China Sea to the west and the Sulu Sea to the southeast.

To the south of Busuanga are the islands Coron and Culion.

The western 1/3 of the island is under the Busuanga municipality, while the eastern 2/3s belong to the Coron municipality.

Busuanga is famous as a diving location. Near the end of World War II (1939-1945), the US Navy bombed and sank a Japanese ship. Its wrecks lie in Coron Bay - a natural anchorage close to the town of Coron.

Nearby Coron Island boasts the beautiful Barracuda and Kayangan lakes. Barracuda is known for its fabled gigantic barracudas and thermoclines.

Siete Pecados is one of the best places to snorkel in Coron. It is popularized by the shoot of a local TV show of a mermaid love story. Travelers can experience swimming in an aquarium, a great variety of fishes and beautiful corals. Recommended time to snorkel is between 1-2 PM. The current is strong in the morning. 

Busuanga is Palawan's "miniature version" with smaller islands in close range. The resorts can arrange boat rental. A good idea is to head down to Coron's Market Pier and get a boat captain. Boats handle around 6 passengers. 

On its way to Puerto Princesa, SuperFerry calls at Coron. It leaves Manila every Friday afternoon and arrives early Saturday morning in Coron. 

Travel 2go provides a bunk bed ferry from Manila and from Puerto Princesa to Coron. 

Calauit Game Preserve and Wildlife Sanctuary is situated on Calauit Island on Busuanga's North side. The reserve was created by Presidential decree in 1976 and houses a variety of African species wandering in the wild.

Maquinit Hot Spring is a beautiful place to hang out. It takes 20 minutes from Coron town market, and costs 300-400 Pesos, depending on the number of passengers and how long they stay. There is an entrance fee. The hot springs comprise 3 areas - the two smaller circular areas are the warmest (above 40 C), and the third larger area is 36 C. 

Other activities can be arranged at the Discovery Bar. These include mountain bike tours, horseback riding, jungle treks.

Busuanga Island Philippines cruise terminal

Most cruise ships to Busuanga Island dock (anchor) at Coron Bay near Coron - port town on the east-southern coast. Some ships may dock at Busuanga - port town on the island's western coast.
